title: A new test never reads the checkout's own origin/main, so a merge that moves main cannot turn a ready run red
why: INCIDENT (coordinator 23:57 CST Nov 14, relayed to triage as data; its read unless marked): PR #3448 (branch rct-carry-main-merge, step carry-forgives-main-merge, lane review-carries-by-tree) had a ready run, run 43682083778 at head c6b4139f1d62, marked 23:41 CST. The coordinator says it went red at 23:55: four new tests in the PR read the checkout's real origin/main (stale_tip_fixture asserts main_tip() equals fx.M), and #3438's merge at 23:49:53 CST moved main during the run, so the assertion failed. The PR had passed the lane's own runs, three review rounds and the lane lint. About 14 min of CI wasted (23:41 to 23:55, the coordinator's arithmetic, one run, n=1). MISTAKE (building-guard-needs-incident): a test fixture depends on the live remote of the checkout it runs in, so its result changes when another PR merges. HARM IT STOPS: a red ready run after a moving main, which costs a CI cycle and holds the PR's hand-in. GUARD (either; the first act of the lane is to pick one and name why): (1) a check that fails a test or fixture that reads the checkout's own origin/main (or main_tip() of the real checkout) instead of the fixture's own bare origin; or (2) a line in the reviewer's brief: probe each new test for a dependency on the live remote (state that moves with other merges). A check must pass the scanner rules (comment openers inside strings) and must go red on this incident's fixture first (verification-trust-guard-after-red). READ BY TRIAGE (REST, 23:59 CST): PR #3448 is open, draft, head c6b4139f1d629ef95892f08f7ce1e56e6b17a956, base main dc35317d3b40, 12 commits, 2 files changed. Run 43682083778 read status queued, event pull_request, head c6b4139f1d62, created 05:40:26Z (23:40 CST), updated 05:41:26Z (23:41 CST), no conclusion. That read does NOT show red or the 23:55 time: the run may have been re-run, or the read lags. The red verdict, the 23:55 time and the four-test cause are the coordinator's read, not confirmed by triage. Not read: the test file, stale_tip_fixture, the job log. RELATED: lane review-carries-by-tree is fixing the fixture now (coordinator 23:57). No design lane yet.
